_meta.label: candidate_goldens.v1
_meta.review_scope: Intended-behavior regression baseline plus a small human calibration comparison over the same development fixtures. Grader-behavior expectations (grader_expected) are distinguished from separate human quality judgments (human_expected) for every graded case.
_meta.not_held_out_validation: These fixtures are not a held-out validation set; the same cases are used both for grader regression and for the human calibration comparison below.
_meta.not_independent_statistical_validation: Precision/recall/F1 computed against human_expected describe agreement on this small, hand-authored, non-random case set only. They are not independent statistical validation of grader accuracy in general.
_meta.not_production_semantic_quality_proof: Passing this suite does not prove production semantic quality. Coverage and completeness remain provisional lexical/id heuristics; semantic groundedness uses an offline Fake grader; live semantic evaluation is deferred.
_meta.evaluation_profile_status: evaluation.candidate.v1 remains provisional. Frozen production evaluation.v1 remains deferred and unfrozen pending an independent held-out human-labeled set and/or a live semantic grader.
_meta.note: Candidate labels for calibration development — not an independent validation set and not frozen evaluation.v1. Grader regression and human calibration are computed and reported separately against these same fixtures.
_meta.class_distribution_note: Counts below include starter + expanded + human-calibration-closeout fixtures used for grader regression and human calibration development (not held-out validation).

cases.scenario: Paraphrased plan coverage exposes lexical false-negative risk

plan: Analyze renewable energy adoption rates across utilities
findings: Examine clean power uptake trends among electric providers.
candidate.draft: Examine clean power uptake trends among electric providers.

grader_expected.rationale: Semantically related paraphrase fails lexical plan-token completeness.
grader_expected.known_heuristic_limitation: Primary known limitation: lexical completeness false negatives on paraphrase.

human_expected.rationale: A well-supported report that fulfills the plan using semantically equivalent paraphrases is acceptable to a human reviewer. Provisional lexical completeness produces a known semantic false negative here: the grader fails on lexical non-overlap even though the paraphrase covers the plan's intent.

grader_expected.rationale: The test-only preview omits the 'Findings:' label, producing STRUCTURE_MISSING_SECTION even though the candidate's own draft and plan are otherwise valid.
grader_expected.known_heuristic_limitation: This exercises the structure gate's label-search defensively; production formatting (format_research_report) always emits all four required labels, so this case does not represent an observed production defect.

Production formatting always creates these labels; this case is formatter/structure-gate regression coverage, not evidence of an observed production formatting defect.
